description: A Java class extending ListActivity that displays a list of contacts with phone numbers, allowing selection and displaying the selected contact's phone details.

classes.name: List7
classes.description: An activity displaying a list of contacts with phone numbers, handling item selection to show contact details.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets layout, queries contacts with phone numbers, and sets up the list adapter.

methods.name: onItemSelected
methods.description: Handles list item selection, retrieves contact info from cursor, and updates the display with contact's phone details.

methods.name: onNothingSelected
methods.description: Empty handler for when no list item is selected.
